name: SDC Training & Regularization Setup
definition: Training pipeline for Self-Supervised Dual Contouring using Curriculum DeepSDF as the DIN, with regularization applied late in training.
summary: SDC Training & Regularization Setup is a self-supervised pipeline that reconstructs implicit surfaces by jointly training an encoder and implicit field, distinguished by late-stage mesh-based regularization aligning the SDF with SDC-extracted geometry.
